cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.8)
project(roshanavi_examples)

# Sample nodes bundled with roshanavi (tutorial, demo and test targets).
#   C++ (rclcpp): image_filter, blob_detector   -> tracing shows receive + processing
#   Python (rclpy): audio_level, state_machine, executor_busy_demo (+ busy_demo_driver)
#                                               -> tracing shows the receive count only
#   Pipeline sample (C++, composable AND standalone): pipeline_source, pipeline_relay,
#                  pipeline_sink (docs/design/nodes.md), generated by scripts/gen_pipeline.py

if(NOT CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD)
  set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
  set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
endif()
if(CMAKE_COMPILER_IS_GNUCXX OR CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
  add_compile_options(-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
endif()
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
endif()

find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
find_package(ament_cmake_python REQUIRED)
find_package(rclcpp REQUIRED)
find_package(rclcpp_components REQUIRED)
find_package(roshanavi_examples_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(sensor_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(std_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(vision_msgs REQUIRED)

# Pure image functions (no ROS): shared by both image nodes and the unit tests.
add_library(image_ops STATIC src/image_ops.cpp)
target_include_directories(image_ops PUBLIC
  $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>)
set_target_properties(image_ops PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)

add_executable(image_filter src/image_filter_node.cpp)
target_link_libraries(image_filter image_ops rclcpp::rclcpp ${sensor_msgs_TARGETS})

add_executable(blob_detector src/blob_detector_node.cpp)
target_link_libraries(blob_detector image_ops rclcpp::rclcpp ${sensor_msgs_TARGETS}
  ${vision_msgs_TARGETS})

install(TARGETS image_filter blob_detector DESTINATION lib/${PROJECT_NAME})

# Relay pipeline sample: one shared library of three components (loadable into a
# ComposableNodeContainer) and one executable per component (one process per node).
add_library(pipeline_components SHARED
  src/pipeline_source_node.cpp src/pipeline_relay_node.cpp src/pipeline_sink_node.cpp
  src/heavy_nodes.cpp)
target_include_directories(pipeline_components PUBLIC
  $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>
  $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>)
target_link_libraries(pipeline_components PUBLIC
  rclcpp::rclcpp rclcpp_components::component ${roshanavi_examples_msgs_TARGETS}
  ${sensor_msgs_TARGETS})
rclcpp_components_register_node(pipeline_components
  PLUGIN "roshanavi_examples::PipelineSource" EXECUTABLE pipeline_source)
rclcpp_components_register_node(pipeline_components
  PLUGIN "roshanavi_examples::PipelineRelay" EXECUTABLE pipeline_relay)
rclcpp_components_register_node(pipeline_components
  PLUGIN "roshanavi_examples::PipelineSink" EXECUTABLE pipeline_sink)
# heavy_source / heavy_sink: big Image / PointCloud2 streams for scripts/bench_heavy.py
rclcpp_components_register_node(pipeline_components
  PLUGIN "roshanavi_examples::HeavySource" EXECUTABLE heavy_source)
rclcpp_components_register_node(pipeline_components
  PLUGIN "roshanavi_examples::HeavySink" EXECUTABLE heavy_sink)
install(TARGETS pipeline_components
  ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib LIBRARY DESTINATION lib RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)

# Python nodes: the module (importable for tests) + `ros2 run` entry scripts.
ament_python_install_package(${PROJECT_NAME})
install(PROGRAMS scripts/audio_level scripts/state_machine scripts/executor_busy_demo
  scripts/busy_demo_driver DESTINATION lib/${PROJECT_NAME})

install(DIRECTORY launch DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME})

if(BUILD_TESTING)
  find_package(ament_cmake_gtest REQUIRED)
  ament_add_gtest(test_image_ops test/test_image_ops.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(test_image_ops image_ops)
  # header-only logic of the pipeline nodes: no ROS needed
  ament_add_gtest(test_pipeline_logic test/test_pipeline_logic.cpp)
  target_include_directories(test_pipeline_logic PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
endif()

ament_package()
